decisions.basis: Pair-0004 NL3 action dossier with source trace and exact state/action facts; binding is explicitly incomplete.

issues.observed: The closed state has entry action EmergencyStop, but the exact source clause also requires the state behavior to include its stated action set; no complete typed action-set equivalence is available in the frozen S4 inputs.
issues.reason: EmergencyStopping is exact and the closed model carries EmergencyStop on entry, but the supplied source requires an action set including Emergency Stop and the model's additional during action is SendObstacleDetected. The exact lifecycle/action comparison is not fully representable by S4 because the contract does not provide a lifecycle phase.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The required EmergencyStop action is present on entry, so a narrower single-action interpretation is satisfied; the candidate concerns the unrepresentable full action-set comparison.
issues.title: Emergency stop action carrier mismatch

issues.basis: NL3; source lifecycle projection for EmergencyStopping; FCSTM state action inventory and transition effect inventory.
issues.expected: EmergencyStopping sends the Obstacle Detected signal as a state behavior effect.
issues.observed: The closed state has a during action SendObstacleDetected, but no exact state effect carrier emits the required signal; transition effects are only R45RouteToken assignments.
issues.reason: The source requires EmergencyStopping to send Obstacle Detected, while the closed model's during action is SendObstacleDetected and its transition effects only assign the route token. The precise state effect is not represented by S6, which applies to transition effects.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The action name SendObstacleDetected may represent the intended signal emission, but the supplied typed closed-model facts do not establish state-effect equivalence.
issues.title: Emergency stopping signal effect mismatch

issues.basis: NL2; exact source transition tr_0008; closed transitions line 24/25/26 exit to [*] and line 36 guarded InMotion-to-Stopping; macro ownership and protected member inventory show lowering, but no complete direct endpoint join is supplied.
issues.expected: InMotion transitions to Stopping as the authored transition relation.
issues.observed: The closed model reaches Stopping only through a guarded outer transition after child transitions exit to [*]; no direct closed transition carrying the authored endpoint relation is present.
issues.reason: The authored InMotion-to-Stopping endpoint is lowered into child exits and a guarded outer transition. The closed model has no direct exact transition with the required InMotion-to-Stopping endpoint and trigger relation; the missing direct endpoint is therefore a structural gap under this atomic endpoint contract.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The compiler lowering may semantically implement the source macro through child exits plus the guarded outer edge; the supplied closure does not provide the complete protected macro join required to establish that equivalence.
issues.title: Stopping route uses an indirect guarded exit

issues.basis: NL2; exact source transition tr_0009; closed transitions line 27/28/29 exit to [*] and line 37 guarded InMotion-to-EmergencyStopping; protected macro closure is incomplete for direct endpoint equivalence.
issues.expected: InMotion transitions to EmergencyStopping when an obstacle is detected.
issues.observed: The closed model uses child-to-[*] transitions followed by a guarded outer InMotion-to-EmergencyStopping transition; no direct closed transition carries the complete authored endpoint and obstacle relation.
issues.reason: The authored InMotion-to-EmergencyStopping endpoint is lowered into child exits and a guarded outer transition. The closed model has no direct exact transition with the authored endpoint relation and obstacle condition as one transition.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The guarded outer transition targets the exact EmergencyStopping state and may be a valid lowered implementation, but complete macro closure is not supplied.
issues.title: Emergency stopping route uses an indirect guarded exit
